Feeds routing decisions (delegation-protocol R5) and the harness `priors` hook.
Score = verifier score in [0,1]. Update at every task close-out. Retirements
(w≥3 failures on a class) recorded in the notes column with date + reason.

| 2026-11-27 | Secuura/Blockchain Seat W 79th (BUILD, FIX ROUND, Opus 5.5, lane -W, pane %30): PR 2296 after gate 421: ONE commit af5e35fb2d4b on 329fae8c, 5 of the closed 6 files; reverse guarded inside its UPDATE and fed from a file through a two-pass base64 stdin stream so the manifest reaches no command line; impossible dates refuse one row; quoted sentinels; the PRECONDITION and the known limit stated; cells for gate 421's nine once-surviving mutants and the two apply terms. By its own runs: suite 133 of 133 with 20 repeats, 85 mutants (83 killed by named cells, the declared pair masked by each other and killed together), shell suites 134 of 134; hook verdict quoted as NOT a pass. Wrap verified at source by Wednesday (history heading 1 with control and first line; HANDOVER 6,596 B, DECLARED 7,553 B, DESIGN_ADDENDUM 4,950 B). Strong: its plan mail listed seven brief facts measured wrong; it asked plainly whether its own mechanism was too clever for a documented rollback; Wednesday's condition (c) led it to find, BEFORE writing code, that a doubled or extended stream would have committed before the bad tail arrived, and it redesigned pass 2 to hold its transaction to the end of the stream; red-first on three arms incl. the refusal switched off; it named the load on the machine by pid and command and touched no other seat's process (the stray grep was Wednesday's own). Deductions: a suite cell once executed header text naming docker (daemon down, nothing ran; fixed and declared); a tool-decoded escape made its first quoting a no-op (caught by its own test); an early throwaway Postgres before the plan answer (licensed by the stamp, declared); a typed time, corrected. | 2026-11-27 | Secuura/Blockchain Seat S 131st (READ-ONLY measurement on KINTSUGI plus a licensed public chain lookup, Sonnet 5.5, lane -S, pane %33): gate 421's G421-1 under Wednesday's own authority: are the 10 confirmed anchor rows behind the stuck certifications real Cardano preview transactions or test-mode mocks. Strong: W-1, found by reading the code before touching the box (the mock confirmation has no caller, so a mock row stays at submitted), offered as a claim with its limits and with the consequence that leg B's zero is not evidence; when the lookup's positive control failed it STOPPED with the ten unsent, said the negative control then proved nothing, found two earlier seats' notes on the endpoint and asked for exactly two licensed alternatives; found the deployed head readable in another seat's clone; a column guard added because the earlier instrument never read the block columns; 52 local dry cases; privacy pass with the hashes in one file only. # Kam decision sitting — 2026-08-14

> ## 🔴 NEW 2026-08-20 ~09:4x — Secuura/Kintsugi: two dev-box calls from s50 (both small)
> **(1) Seeded `*123` accounts vs unique credentials on the dev box.** The stack ships
> demo's seeded logins; scanners were probing the host within MINUTES of 443 opening.
> Rec: unique credentials (one session's work, agent can generate + record properly).
> **(2) Wallet mnemonic backup location.** Agent correctly refused to write into demo's
> Key Vault on its own authority. Rec: NO dev secrets in demo's vault — it is a
> faucet-funded test wallet, cheap to regenerate; backup waits for Kintsugi's own vault
> if ever needed. One word each.
> *(Also pending your hands: the faucet minute — address + steps on the panel.)*

> ## 🔴 NEW 2026-08-20 ~08:4x — Secuura: does Stuart's "$5000 Founders credits live"
> actually move the 6 Sep expiry? (portal-only check, ~2 min, YOUR eyes)
> Stuart posted on KS-601 (08-19 00:58Z, with screenshot): "Founder credits are live
> ($5000) so good to go." **A new grant does not by itself move the existing credit's
> 6 Sep expiry** — and 6 Sep has been the only dated clock on Kintsugi. The credits
> API 404s for the scoped SP (verified 08-19), so only the portal billing view can
> answer: do the $5000 credits REPLACE/extend the expiring grant, or sit alongside
> it? **Ask: one look at the billing view.** Until you rule, every record keeps the
> 6 Sep clock standing — s50 flagged it precisely so the screenshot does not silently
> read as "the clock moved."

> ## ℹ️ PATTERN FYI 2026-08-20 (extends the #723/#724 item below): s50 found P3 was
> already ON DEMO (#666 merged 08-12, shipped with the 08-14 discharge) while KS-584's
> "never against demo mid-development" hold read otherwise. Third instance of team
> holds being read differently by different hands — one shared rule at the CI cost
> conversation would close the class.

> ## ✅ DONE 2026-08-20 ~08:1x — Kam SENT the re-issue same hour ("email sent").
